ItemID: 1; Title: Joywayus Pressure Gauge 0 to 30 PSI Brass 1/4" Male NPT Thread Lower Mount, Multiple Function; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no current pressure-monitoring project that calls for this range or fitting.

ItemID: 4; Title: 5/16 x 5-1/2" (8 pcs) Hex Lag Screws, 304 Stainless Steel 18/8, Hexagon Head Lag Bolts, Hex Head Wood Screws; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: These long lag screws are too specialized without a specific heavy timber fastening job.

ItemID: 7; Title: AmazonCommercial 44 Gallon Heavy Duty Round Trash/Garbage Can, Grey, 4-pck; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Four large trash cans exceed my current workshop cleanup needs.

ItemID: 9; Title: COSIMIXO 5-Pack Black Heavy Duty Duct Tape, 2 inches x 30 Yards, Strong, Flexible, No Residue, All-Weather and Tear by Hand - Bulk Value for Repairs, Industrial, Professional Use; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Repair tape is useful to me, but five rolls feel excessive without an immediate project.
ItemID: 10; Title: toolant Four Sprial Flute Step Drill Bit, 1/8"-7/8"(3pcs) Impact Ready Titanium Coated Unibit Step Bit, 1/4" Hex Shank Unibit for Metal, Stainless Steel, Aluminum, Wood, Plastic; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Step bits would complement my twist drills for enlarging holes in sheet metal for rivet nuts and other fastening projects.
